samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_div">
    <description>Frequency Divider Module for 100 MHz to 50 MHz, 10 MHz, and 1 MHz Clocks</description>
    
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK_in">Input Clock Signal</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset Signal</input>
        
        <output id="CLK_50">Output Clock Signal at 50 MHz Frequency</output>
        <output id="CLK_10">Output Clock Signal at 10 MHz Frequency</output>
        <output id="CLK_1">Output Clock Signal at 1 MHz Frequency</output>
    </ports>
    
    <implementation>
        // Counter for generating CLK_50
        reg [3:0] cnt_50;
        reg clk_50_reg;
        always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                clk_50_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                clk_50_reg <= ~clk_50_reg;
            end
        end
        
        assign CLK_50 = clk_50_reg;
        
        
        // Counter for generating CLK_10
        reg [3:0] cnt_10;
        reg clk_10_reg;
        always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                cnt_10 <= 4'd0;
                clk_10_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt_10 == 4'd4) begin
                    clk_10_reg <= ~clk_10_reg;
                    cnt_10 <= 4'd0;
                end else begin
                    cnt_10 <= cnt_10 + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        assign CLK_10 = clk_10_reg;
        
        
        // Counter for generating CLK_1
        reg [6:0] cnt_100;
        reg clk_1_reg;
        always @(posedge CLK_in or posedge RST) begin
            if (RST) begin
                cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
                clk_1_reg <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (cnt_100 == 7'd49) begin
                    clk_1_reg <= ~clk_1_reg;
                    cnt_100 <= 7'd0;
                end else begin
                    cnt_100 <= cnt_100 + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        assign CLK_1 = clk_1_reg;
    </implementation>
</module>
